title: Exhaustion assessment — CBI Personal Burnout

items.text: How often do you feel tired?
How often are you physically exhausted?
How often do your daily responsibilities feel unmanageable?
How often are you emotionally exhausted?
How often do you have time to rest after demanding activities?
How often do you think: “I can’t take it anymore”?
How often can you maintain a consistent sleep schedule?
How often do you feel worn out?
How often can you get support when your responsibilities feel difficult?
How often do you feel weak and susceptible to illness?

explanation: This score describes how often you reported physical and psychological exhaustion. It is not a diagnosis or a probability. Lifestyle context and daily logs do not change it.
context_explanation: Four optional researcher-developed questions help personalize wellness support. They are not CBI items and are not scored.

sources.citation: Kristensen TS, Borritz M, Villadsen E, Christensen KB. 2005. The Copenhagen Burnout Inventory: A new tool for the assessment of burnout. Work & Stress 19(3), 192–207.
